newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche says Russia completes debt down payment.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche says Russia completes debt down payment.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Tuesday that Vnesheconombank of the USSR made the last of its monthly instalments that make up a cash down payment agreed upon in a rescheduling of external debt of the former USSR.
Deutsche, acting as chairman of the Bank Advisory Committee, said that Vnesheconombank of the USSR had transferred $95 million to a trust account held with the Bank of England on Monday.

An agreement on comprehensive rescheduling of a portion of the external debt of the former USSR was reached between the Government of the Russian Federation, Vnesheconombank and the Bank Advisory Committee on November 16, 1995.
The payments made by Vnesheconombank since February 1995 now total $1.95 billion, Deutsche said.
